Claydol

Ground Psychic

Hoenn · Generation 3

Claydol is a Ground/Psychic-type Clay Doll Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 108 kg. It evolves from Baltoy. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (120), with a base stat total of 500.
